paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: Layer-wise norm differences from -1 to -5.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates layer-wise norm difference values across LLM layers for five settings labeled by compression factor \(c\) (legend entries \(c=1\) through \(c=5\)). The x-axis is labeled “LLM layer index,” uses a linear scale, and spans indices from 0 to about 15 with regularly spaced major ticks every 2 units (0, 2, 4, …, 14). The y-axis is labeled “Layerwise norm difference,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.6 to 1.0 with major tick labels at 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, and 1.0. Five solid lines with small circular markers are shown: \(c=1\) is red, \(c=2\) is orange, \(c=3\) is yellow, \(c=4\) is green, and \(c=5\) is blue. All five series start near the top of the axis (around 1.0) at the first plotted layer index and drop into the 0.65–0.90 range by the next few layers (for example near layer index 2 the red/orange/yellow/green/blue values are roughly 0.89/0.75/0.68/0.65/0.69), then each descends to a local minimum around layer index 6–7 (all lines near roughly 0.62–0.65 at layer 6–7). Each line then rises to a local peak around layer index 8 (values clustered around roughly 0.81–0.84), followed by a decline into the 0.66–0.75 band across layers 9–13 (e.g., near layer 10 the red/orange/yellow/green/blue values are about 0.66/0.69/0.69/0.69/0.74). Near the right edge, all series increase again, reaching approximately 1.0 at the final plotted layer index (around 14), with intermediate points just before the endpoint showing values in the mid-to-high 0.7s (e.g., near layer 13 the red/orange/yellow/green/blue values are about 0.67/0.72/0.75/0.75/0.77).
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates layer-wise norm differences across LLM layer indices for five settings labeled c=1 through c=5, shown as five colored line series. The x-axis is labeled “LLM layer index,” uses a linear scale, spans approximately 0 to 15, and shows regularly spaced tick labels at intervals of 2 (0, 2, 4, …, 14). The y-axis is labeled “Layerwise norm difference,” uses a linear scale, ranges from 0.6 to 1.0, and shows tick labels at 0.1 increments (0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0). The c=1 series is a red solid line with small circular markers, starting near 1.00 at layer 1, decreasing through about 0.89 (layer 2) and about 0.75 (layer 5) to roughly 0.63 at layer 6, rising to about 0.84 at layer 8, then sitting around 0.66–0.67 across layers 10–13, reaching about 0.83 at layer 14 and about 1.00 at the final layer. The c=2 series is an orange solid line with circular markers, beginning around 0.94 at layer 1, dropping to about 0.74 at layer 2, moving around 0.76–0.80 in layers 3–4, dipping to about 0.64 at layer 6, peaking near 0.82 at layer 8, hovering around 0.67–0.69 from layers 10–12, then increasing to about 0.72 at layer 13 and reaching about 1.00 at the final layer. The c=3 series is a yellow solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.87 at layer 1, falling to about 0.68 at layer 2, staying near 0.79 at layer 3, dropping to about 0.63 at layer 6, rising to around 0.81 at layer 8, then lying near 0.69–0.70 across layers 10–12 before increasing to about 0.75 at layer 13 and reaching about 1.00 at the end. The c=4 series is a green solid line with circular markers, beginning near 0.80 at layer 1, dropping to about 0.65 at layer 2, rising to about 0.80 at layer 3 and about 0.85 at layer 4, declining to about 0.62 at layer 6, increasing to about 0.82 at layer 8, then remaining around 0.68–0.70 from layers 10–13 and reaching about 1.00 at the final layer. The c=5 series is a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.75 at layer 1, dipping to about 0.69 at layer 2, rising to about 0.82 at layer 3, decreasing to about 0.62 at layer 6, rising to about 0.83 at layer 8, then staying around 0.72–0.74 across layers 10–12, increasing to about 0.77 at layer 13, and reaching about 1.00 at the end.
